 Week 10 of the NFL season will come to an end with a Monday Night Football matchup between the Los Angeles Chargers and the Baltimore Ravens. Kickoff is set for 8:15 p.m. ET. The game will broadcast live on ESPN.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Our player props for Monday Night Football tonight target Omarion Hampton , Oronde Gadsden and Zay Flowers .
 Let's dive into our Chargers vs Ravens player props for Monday night.
 Chargers vs Ravens Player Props
 Omarion Hampton Over 10.5 Rushing Attempts (-119, DraftKings) 
 Oronde Gadsden Anytime Touchdown (+500, BetMGM) 
 Zay Flowers Over 69.5 Receiving Yards (-114, FanDuel) 
 Make sure to download the Action Network app for more NFL picks and analysis 
 Chargers vs Ravens Prop Picks, Preview
 No team has failed to live up to expectations more than the Chargers , and Omarion Hampton has been one the biggest disappointments on their roster.
 However, last week against the Texans , Hampton showed positive signs and had his first game with double-digit carries since Week 5.
 He outcarried both Kimani Vidal and Keaton Mitchell and was very efficient, finishing with 13 rushing yards over expected and an average of 4.6 yards per carry.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Ravens defense is strong against the run, but with Hampton showing signs of life, he should continue to get a reasonable workload.
 Pick: Omarion Hampton Over 10.5 Rushing Attempts (-119, DraftKings) 
 Backing any Chargers player to score feels like a risk, but at these odds, you have to wager on Oronde Gadsden . He's had 13 targets across the past three games and leads the Chargers in red-zone targets, having more than the rest of the tight end corps combined.
 The reason that matters is only five teams have allowed more touchdowns to opposing tight ends than the Ravens, and tight ends have actually scored the same number of TDs against them as receivers, with six each, through nine games.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Gadsden is the Chargers' prime red-zone target and should be backed at big odds.
 Pick: Oronde Gadsden Anytime Touchdown (+500, BetMGM) 
 Following two down games in a row, I remain bullish on Zay Flowers for Monday Night Football.
 The arrival of Jacoby Brissett is a huge upgrade over the carousel of backup quarterbacks who've been under center for the Ravens this year. Brissett is not the most dynamic or exciting QB, but he's a solid passer, and we've seen both Trey McBride and Michael Wilson put up big numbers with him on the Cardinals.
 Flowers is the best option in the passing game for the Ravens, and the underlying numbers show a player with a quarterback issue, not a talent one.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement He ran routes on 86% of Ravens dropbacks last week and had an impressive 38% target share. With a serviceable quarterback, Flowers is going to get a lot of work, and he could — and should — torch the Chargers.
 Pick: Zay Flowers Over 69.5 Receiving Yards (-114, FanDuel)
